title: A non-invasive artificial intelligence model for identifying axillary pathological complete response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in breast cancer: a secondary analysis to multicenter clinical trial.
summary: The breast-cancer response model is tested across three external cohorts and a prospective cohort, with pathology-defined response and reported comparison to radiologists.
ai_technology: AI model for pathology-defined axillary response after neoadjuvant chemotherapy
organization: Cancer Center; Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital (Guangdong Academy of Medical Sciences); Southern Medical University
